question: does dropping the reference name depend on whether the name also appears inside the fact value

design.manipulation: the fact value is written once with the reference name inside it (在…上 frame) and once without it (…着的 attributive frame); name field, relation, other entity and predicate are identical within a pair
design.sameProposition: human-confirmed per pair: the relation, the object that acts and the predicate are the same; the only difference is whether the name is repeated inside the value
design.notDeletionEquivalent: the two frames are not related by deleting the name, because Chinese locative frames need 在…上 or a bare 上; wording differs and that is recorded
design.length: every with-name value is 3 characters longer (the name plus the frame); this pairing cannot separate form from length and no padding was added to either side

checks.fact: frozen cf24 scorer verdict, reported separately

syntaxRule: same as syntax-frame-r4: name repeated, 的…的 nesting, or name+的 immediately followed by the other entity / the relation phrase
pairDivergence: a pair diverges when its two members differ in reference retention
declaredDecision: if an arm diverges on at least 3 of the 6 pairs, and in the same direction (kept with the name in the value, dropped without it), that arm shows input-form dependence. Fewer than 3, or mixed directions, means the pairing does not support the exemplar hypothesis and no insertion training is designed from it
regression: cf24, final24 and moved24 stay unchanged as regression sets; the scoring rules are not modified
declaredBefore: written before any model ran on these probes
